name: smwgraphics-paper-mario-styled-mario
title: Paper Mario Styled Mario
description:
These graphics were completely inspired on Paper Mario, thus creating a new design for the player!
It also includes:

  • Poses for castle destruction cutscenes
  • Overworld sprites
  • Blushing faces
  • A custom hammer that's used in castle #3 destruction cutscene
  • Alternate poses of your choice! They are located at the very end of the main graphics file.

No custom palette needed, and the 32x32 Player Tilemap Patch is required to work!

Be sure to give credits to paveldechev0604 for these sprites, ripped from this sheet!
